name: C1.1 Patients missing required demographic fields (sex, birth year, race or ethnicity)
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE p.gender_concept_id IS NULL OR p.year_of_birth IS NULL OR p.race_concept_id IS NULL OR p.ethnicity_concept_id IS NULL

name: C1.2 Patients with an unmapped, non-standard, invalid or wrong-domain diagnosis concept
description: Detects degradation D1 (unmapped diagnoses). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concept c WHERE c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id AND c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL AND c.domain_id = 'Condition'))

name: CO2.1 Patients without an observation period or without any visit
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM visit_occurrence v WHERE v.person_id = p.person_id)

name: CO2.2 Patients with type 2 diabetes without any HbA1c result
description: Detects degradation D4 (missing HbA1c, MNAR). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co JOIN concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004410 AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL)

name: P3.1 Patients with an implausible birth year (1900 or earlier, in the future, or age over 110) or a diagnosis dated before birth
description: Detects degradation D3 (sentinel birth dates). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE p.year_of_birth <= 1900 OR p.year_of_birth > EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM op.observation_period_end_date) - p.year_of_birth > 110) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM co.condition_start_date) < p.year_of_birth)

name: P3.2 Patients with an HbA1c result in percent outside the plausible range (3-20 %)
description: Detects degradation D2 (HbA1c unit mislabeling). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004410 AND (m.unit_concept_id = 8554 OR m.unit_source_value = '%') AND (m.value_as_number < 3 OR m.value_as_number > 20))

name: CC4.1 Patients with a diagnosis outside their observation period
description: Detects degradation D5 (truncated observation periods). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = co.person_id AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date))

name: CC4.2 Patients with an HbA1c result in the diabetic range (6.5 % or higher) but no diabetes diagnosis
description: Detects degradation D1 (unmapped diagnoses) and D2 (HbA1c unit mislabeling). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id = 3004410 AND m.value_as_number >= 6.5) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co JOIN concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201820)

name: CU5.1 Patients with records dated after the data release date
description: Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_start_date > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_release_date), CURRENT_DATE) FROM cdm_source)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_date > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_release_date), CURRENT_DATE) FROM cdm_source)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id AND op.observation_period_end_date > (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_release_date), CURRENT_DATE) FROM cdm_source))

name: CU5.2 Patients whose clinical records stop more than 2 years before the end of their observation period
description: Detects degradation D6 (stale extract). Reports the share of patients with at least one faulty record; 0% means the check passed.
query: SELECT person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation_period op WHERE op.person_id = p.person_id AND op.observation_period_end_date > (SELECT MAX(d) FROM (SELECT MAX(co.condition_start_date) AS d FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id UNION ALL SELECT MAX(m.measurement_date) FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id) x) + INTERVAL '2 years')
